entries.title: A new update is on the way!
entries.description:
We are currently developing an AI Guide Reviewer designed to handle and review all guides comprehensively. Here is what to expect:

Fast Processing: Your guide will be reviewed in just 3 to 5 seconds, with immediate approval or cancellation based on policy compliance.
Intelligent Review: The system will be smarter and more accurate, eliminating confusion and reducing errors.

entries.title: Comprehensive Review System Overhaul & Critical Data Fixes
entries.description:
Community Love Refinement: Transitioned to a premium Black & White aesthetic with a smart dynamic layout (Auto-Marquee for 6+ reviews).
Enhanced Review Management: Added "Edit My Review" functionality and a robust user avatar system with smart fallback support for broken images.
Critical Reliability Fix: Resolved a high-priority bug that caused guide submissions to fail silently, ensuring 100% data persistence to Supabase.
System Stability: Fixed TypeScript build errors and optimized error handling to ensure seamless performance and deployments on Vercel.
